description: A corner unit, which here means two windows instead of one and a draft to match. A bed, a footlocker, a sink that runs brown for a ten-count before it clears. The door is steel, and it's the only thing in here anyone spent money on.

window.description: A broad window with a hard chrome frame, spotless in a way that suggests somebody is paid for it.
window.name: the window
